example_sentences_in_bangla: খাটুনির চোটে তার গা-গতর ব্যথা করে উঠেছে।
দীর্ঘ যাত্রায় গা-গতর ক্লান্ত হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The hard labor has caused pain in his body and limbs.
The long journey has left his entire body exhausted.
note: This idiom is commonly used in contexts of physical strain from manual work, reflecting rural Bengali life.
